### Archer To Report Second Quarter 2026 Operating Update and Financial Results on August 10, 2026


Jul 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/823642595/files/doc_news/Archer-To-Report-Second-Quarter-2026-Operating-Update-and-Financial-Results-on-August-10-2026-2026.pdf)


SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Archer Aviation Inc. (NYSE: ACHR) will report its second quarter 2026 operating update and financial results after market close on Monday, August 10, 2026. Archer will host a live webcast to discuss its results at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.


The live webcast and replay will be available at[investors.archer.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.archer.com&esheet=54577233&newsitemid=20260727132199&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.archer.com&index=1&md5=108e3d6d9cd49b5e91b58f387efd9444) .To listen to the conference call, you can join the webcast by visiting[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/810358512](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F810358512&esheet=54577233&newsitemid=20260727132199&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F810358512&index=2&md5=ad842b3a10b9bc5a4a46006a08a08f9d) .


Archer will also utilize Say Technologies’ Q&A Platform to allow shareholders to submit and vote on questions by visiting[https://app.saytechnologies.com/archer-2026-q2](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.saytechnologies.com%2Farcher-2026-q2&esheet=54577233&newsitemid=20260727132199&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.saytechnologies.com%2Farcher-2026-q2&index=3&md5=7700493d6580f4a741c5a69346659f6e) .
